// diagnostic

E3217

C library `{lib}` has no binding named `{member}`.

What

C library `{lib}` has no binding named `{member}`.

Why

Neither the binding cache `.jet/bindings/c/{lib}.jet` nor an `#Import c.{lib}: module` overlay declares `{member}`; without a cache the library binds nothing.

Fix

Import the header by path (`use name: "<dir>/{lib}.h"`) so the compiler binds it, refresh the cache with `jet inspect bind <header.h> --pkg {lib}`, or declare `{member}` in `#Import c.{lib}: module`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3217: tests/ui/cffi_e3217_missing_binding_member.stderr.

Error [jet.CBindingMemberMissing]: C library `c` has no binding named `strlen`.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3217_missing_binding_member.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |     print(libc.strlen("hello"))
    |           ^^^^
 Why: Neither the binding cache `.jet/bindings/c/c.jet` nor an `#Import c.c: module` overlay declares `strlen`; without a cache the library binds nothing.
 Fix: Import the header by path (`use name: "<dir>/c.h"`) so the compiler binds it, refresh the cache with `jet inspect bind <header.h> --pkg c`, or declare `strlen` in `#Import c.c: module`.
